integrity: A mathematical proof covers all integers m>=2,t>=1. Exact finite enumeration checks eight bounded parameter pairs; these tests do not certify the unbounded theorem or originality.
scientific_limitations: Binary extended Hamming family only; column-support joint corrections under uniform syndromes. The maximum generalized covering radius is previously known; the claimed contribution is the exact per-syndrome optimal correction multiplicity and distribution. No decoding-time or physical performance improvement is claimed. Priority is not independently verified; the recent geometric framework has been inspected only through its abstract.
title: Joint nearest-cover multiplicities of binary extended Hamming codes
